rationale: Bacteria: no full text could be accessed (publisher hosts unreachable from the agent environment), so nothing is verified. Best lead: Rousk & Baath 2011 doi:10.1111/j.1574-6941.2011.01106.x compares bacterial/fungal turnover times from growth assays; Hu et al. 2025 doi:10.1111/gcb.70036. Blocker: full text; growth-derived turnover may not equal maintenance turnover at reference temperature. Next human step: obtain full text and decide whether growth-based turnover is acceptable.

Saprotrophic fungi: same blocker as bacteria; Rousk & Baath 2011 is the best lead (fungal turnover from acetate-in-ergosterol). Next human step: obtain full text; Fatichi et al. 2019 tau and gcb.15550 (issue seed) should be checked for group-specific values.

Arbuscular mycorrhiza: no candidate identified in the searches run (4 queries). Next human step: targeted search for AM extraradical hyphal turnover and decide whether hyphal turnover is a valid proxy for maintenance turnover.

Ectomycorrhiza: leads doi:10.1007/s11104-013-1630-3 and doi:10.1016/j.soilbio.2012.08.027 (extramatrical mycelium production and turnover); not accessed. Blocker: full text; mycelium turnover is not maintenance turnover. Next human step: obtain full text and judge compatibility.
